endorsements.name: Nicolas Fischbach
endorsements.label: Layer 2, Routing Protocols, Router Security & Forensics
endorsements.description: Our talk will cover the (in)security of layer 2 protocols (CDP, xTP, HSRP, VRRP, VLANs, etc) and its consequences. We will also discuss routing protocols attacks and how to (try to) protect your infrastructure. The architecture, security, secure management and forensics of routers and switches will also be covered. This last part of the talk will be complementary to the presentation from FX of Phenoelit.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 10
